text:
Sophia: Quick sync — need to schedule a design review for the Unified Streaming SDK + Console integration. Scope: API surface, auth/keys, streaming UX, telemetry hooks. Pre-read: https://drive.redwood.dev/unified-streaming/PREREAD (please skim before voting).

Calendar-bot: Proposed slots (vote with emoji):
• Thu 3/10 10:00-11:00 PT :one:
• Thu 3/10 16:00-17:00 PT :two: (EU friendly)
• Fri 3/11 09:00-10:00 PT :three:

Sophia: Pref is Thu 10am PT but open to the EU-friendly slot if execs want to join. Agenda below — keeping to 60m.

Elaine (PM): Thanks — adding a short canary checklist too. If you RSVP, please add one-line read status: `skimmed`, `read`, or `need time`. Helps decide if we should split into 2 sessions.

Omar: I can do Thu 10am PT. `skimmed`.

Ryan: I have a conflict at 10am. Preference :two: or Fri :three:. `need time` (short notice for pre-read).

Maria: I can join Thu 16:00 PT (:two:) and can cover Console UX slides. `read`.

Sophia: Noted. If we pick :two:, will record and drop notes for NA folks. Would like at least one eng owner from runtime and one from SDK present. @Omar can you cover SDK perf tradeoffs?

Omar: Yup, will do a 10min perf/latency rundown + tradeoffs.

Elaine (PM): Draft agenda (paste to calendar description):
```
1) 5m - Quick context & goals (Elaine)
2) 15m - API design + auth (Sophia)
3) 10m - SDK surface & perf tradeoffs (Omar)
4) 15m - Console flows & telemetry (Maria)
5) 10m - Q&A + action items (All)
```

Sophia: Pre-read checklist (copy into your RSVP):
- confirm you've looked at `openapi.yaml` section (line items: streaming endpoints, auth headers)
- run the tiny sample (link in pre-read) and note any auth errors
- skim Console mockups (pages 3-7) and mark UX concerns
- flag any backward-compat constraints for SDK v1

devex-bot: Reminder: attach a tiny repro gist if you hit auth problems: https://gist.redwood.dev/stream-auth-debug

Ryan: Ok I can do :two: (Thu 16:00). I'll try to `skim` before then.

Sophia: Great — seems like :two: is winning. Final ask: if you marked `need time`, please add which bits you want highlighted so we can surface them first.

Ryan: Mostly the auth edge cases and client reconnection semantics.

Elaine (PM): Will update calendar invite to Thu 3/10 16:00 PT and add links + slides. Action items before the meeting: please leave 1-2 comments inline on the pre-read doc so we can triage ahead of time.

Sophia: Thanks all — I'll prepare a 1-slide summary of perf numbers + fallback policy. See you Thu :wave:

calendar-bot: Event created: "Unified Streaming SDK + Console design review" — Thu 3/10 16:00 PT. Invitees: Sophia, Omar, Maria, Ryan, Elaine (PM). Recording enabled.
